remarks: Luxurious and stylish combo-double unit apartment boasts amazing views of LI sound and Manhattan. With hard floors throughout, high ceilings (8.5ft) and floor to ceiling windows, this apartment has a unique flow. I features Lutron electric shades in every room and every closet were built-in with drawers and shelves for ample storage. The spacious foyer and powder room flow into a great room (balcony attached) and kitchen ideal for entertaining. The adjacent room is perfect for an office, TV room or a playroom. There is also a walk-in laundry room outfitted with cabinets and a sink (washer/dryer as well). The two bedrooms are spacious and each have a full bathroom one of which has a double sink, stall shower and a jacuzzi tub. The den is perfect for a sitting room or whatever your needs may be. It also has a balcony attached. The master bedroom suite has his and hers walk in closets and two other bonus closets all with build-in shelves and drawers. The master bath has double sinks, stall shower and a jacuzzi tub. Park Tower Stamford offers great amenities: 24 hrs concierge and security, free shuttle to the Stamford train station, full gym, pool, theater room, billiards room, social room and a rooftop with three gas grills and plenty of tables and chairs to enjoy lunch/dinner with spectacular views.
